help.retryMeaning: After a step finishes, the Runtime Gate checks whether its output meets the requirements, such as a nonempty evidence directory and a completed checklist. If validation fails, the retry budget controls how many recovery attempts the Agent receives.
help.retryZero: 0 or blank: a gate failure stops execution immediately, with no recovery attempt.
help.retryAttempts: N: after a gate failure, the Agent receives up to N additional attempts. Each attempt includes the failure reason so the Agent can fix the problem and resubmit.
help.retryExample: For a “Test and deliver” step requiring a nonempty evidence/ directory, a retry budget of 3 gives the Agent three additional attempts. If test logs are missing on the first submission, the gate reports “evidence required but none provided”; the Agent can add evidence files and resubmit.
help.retryRecommendation: A value of 2–3 is usually enough. A larger budget may waste resources retrying problems the Agent cannot resolve.
help.checklistMeaning: The checklist the Agent must complete during the step. The Agent sees these items during execution and checks each one through the API.
help.checklistBehavior: With checklistRequired: true, the gate requires every item to be completed. Only items explicitly allowing not applicable may be marked that way when their configured condition is met, with a reason; this does not count as a passed check.
help.checklistFormat: A JSON array whose items contain id and text, for example:
help.checklistConditional: Upgrade the Executor Runtime before setting allowNotApplicable: true and a nonempty notApplicableWhen. During execution, report NOT_APPLICABLE, checked: false and a specific reason. Required items without this configuration must still pass.
help.policyMeaning: Runtime Gate validation rules for step completion. After the Agent submits completion, the gate checks the output against the policy.
help.evidenceRequired: Whether the Agent must declare evidenceRefs (a list of evidence file paths) when submitting completion.
help.requiredArtifacts: File or directory prefixes required in the output directory. For example, ["evidence/"] requires a nonempty evidence/ directory.
help.checklistRequired: Whether all checklist items must be completed or marked not applicable with a reason under their configured conditions. Empty checklists and unprocessed items cannot pass.
